name: llvm-apr-benchmark-submissions
description: A collection of submissions and results for the LLVM Automatic Patch Repair (APR) benchmark that measures how well automated program-repair systems generate correct patches for real LLVM code defects. It evaluates models' ability to produce syntactically and semantically correct fixes that match reference repairs or pass test-suite checks. The benchmark captures both patch generation and ranking performance across multiple submitted systems.
reputation: A niche, specialized benchmark used mainly by program-repair and PL research groups; limited broader community adoption.
